title: aeluropus littoralis subsp. micrantherus
intro: Aeluropus littoralis subsp. micrantherus, commonly known as Dune Grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is a type of grass that is native to the Mediterranean region and is known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Dune Grass include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Dune Grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-tumor activities.
